description: Build a list of the companies a venture capital firm or accelerator backs. Give investor or accelerator names (Y Combinator, a16z, Sequoia, Accel, Index Ventures, Founders Fund, Greylock, Lightspeed, Khosla, First Round, Techstars, Antler) or any portfolio page URL. Returns one flat row per portfolio company (name, domain, website, description, and stage, batch, or status where the source gives it) plus one free summary row per source saying how it was read or why it returned nothing. Y Combinator is filterable by batch, industry, region, status, and search words. Pages are read from the investor's own site and robots.txt is obeyed. A run that does not succeed is returned as an error with its run ID. Read-only; requires an APIFY_TOKEN and is billed per company row with a domain.

investors.description: Investors or accelerators by name (Y Combinator, a16z, Sequoia, Accel, Index Ventures, Founders Fund, Greylock, Lightspeed, Khosla, First Round, Techstars, Antler) or portfolio page URLs. Up to 25. Default Y Combinator.

max_charge_usd.description: Optional. Number or text, in USD. The run stops before a charge that would pass this amount.

max_companies_per_source.description: Number or text. Company rows per source, up to 10000. Each company row with a domain is billed. Default 500.

max_detail_pages.description: Number or text. Company pages opened per source, up to 1000. Default 200.

only_new.description: Skip companies an earlier run returned for the same source (free). Default false.

open_company_pages.description: Open per company pages when a portfolio page links only to them. Default true.

proxy_mode.description: auto reads a site that refuses a direct request through the Apify proxy; direct never uses a proxy. A reliability setting; it does not change the price. Default auto.

state_key.description: Optional name for the only new companies memory.

yc_batches.description: Y Combinator only. Batches as S24, W25, or Summer 2024. Empty: every batch.

yc_company_pages.description: Y Combinator only. true opens each company's YC page (one page per company, up to max_detail_pages) to read founder names, founder LinkedIn links, and the open role count. Needs open_company_pages true. Default false.

yc_industries.description: Y Combinator only. Industries as the directory writes them, for example B2B, Fintech.

yc_query.description: Y Combinator only. Words to search the directory for.

yc_regions.description: Y Combinator only. Regions as the directory writes them, for example Europe.

yc_status.description: Y Combinator only. Any of active, acquired, public, inactive.

name: build_portfolio_list
title: Build a portfolio company list
